title: Panch Mahapurusha yoga: the five great person yogas | Ask Tota
description: Ruchaka, Bhadra, Hamsa, Malavya and Shasha: a planet in its own or exaltation sign in a kendra. The rules, how common they are, and what each means.
og_description: Five planets, five yogas, one simple rule. Roughly a third of charts have at least one. What each describes and what makes it count.
h1: panch mahapurusha yoga: five great person yogas, one simple rule
dek: when mars, mercury, jupiter, venus or saturn sits in its own or exaltation sign in a kendra, the chart gets one of five named yogas: ruchaka, bhadra, hamsa, malavya or shasha. each describes a planet at full strength in a strong position. roughly a third of charts have at least one.

card_dek: ruchaka, bhadra, hamsa, malavya, shasha: a planet in its own or exaltation sign in a kendra. about a third of charts have one.
llms_desc: the five Panch Mahapurusha yogas (Ruchaka from Mars, Bhadra from Mercury, Hamsa from Jupiter, Malavya from Venus, Shasha from Saturn), the rule of own or exaltation sign in a kendra, which signs qualify, what each yoga describes, roughly how often they occur, strength conditions, and myths.

faq.a: a set of five yogas formed when mars, mercury, jupiter, venus or saturn occupies its own sign or exaltation sign in a kendra, the 1st, 4th, 7th or 10th house. mahapurusha means great person.

faq.q: what are the five mahapurusha yogas?
faq.a: ruchaka (mars), bhadra (mercury), hamsa (jupiter), malavya (venus) and shasha (saturn).
mars in aries or scorpio, its own signs, or capricorn, its exaltation, in a kendra from the lagna. it is traditionally linked to courage, leadership and physical strength.
mercury in gemini or virgo, which is both its own and exaltation sign, in a kendra. it is linked to intelligence, eloquence and skill in communication and business.
jupiter in sagittarius or pisces, its own signs, or cancer, its exaltation, in a kendra. it is linked to wisdom, ethics, respect and a teacher's nature.
venus in taurus or libra, its own signs, or pisces, its exaltation, in a kendra. it is linked to charm, artistic taste, comfort and harmonious relationships.
saturn in capricorn or aquarius, its own signs, or libra, its exaltation, in a kendra. it is linked to authority, discipline, endurance and influence over groups or institutions.

faq.q: how common is panch mahapurusha yoga?
faq.a: each individual yoga appears in roughly one chart in twelve to eighteen. taken together, roughly a third of charts have at least one of the five. strength conditions decide how much each matters.

faq.q: are sun and moon part of mahapurusha yoga?
faq.a: no. the five yogas use only the five 'star planets', mars, mercury, jupiter, venus and saturn. the sun and moon and the nodes are excluded.

faq.q: is mahapurusha yoga counted from the moon too?
faq.a: the classical definition counts kendras from the lagna. some astrologers also accept kendras from the moon as a weaker form.

combustion, heavy affliction by malefics, the planet being in a very early or late degree of the sign, or a weak lagna lord. some texts also say the yoga gives less if the planet is with the sun or moon.

faq.q: when does a mahapurusha yoga give results?
faq.a: most clearly in the dasha or antardasha of the planet forming it. as with all yogas, the chart shows the potential and the dasha shows the timing.
